method: Current official patriarchal, archdiocesan, monastery, and Moscow Patriarchate records were reconciled body by body. Search engines and general directories were used only for discovery. Exact current bodies are published beneath their competent Church parents. Institutional telephone numbers and emails are preserved only where the body or its Church publishes them as public contact details. Clergy mobile numbers remain unpublished. Numbered gaps, unenumerated subordinate bodies, historical-only identities, affiliation-unclear bodies, and institutions without a distinct worship body remain unpublished.

candidates.name: Unresolved number 13 in the Beirut churches sequence
candidates.status: hold until the Archdiocese publishes an exact current body at that position
candidates.reason: The live official Beirut sequence names current bodies at numbers 1 through 12 and 14 through 17. A missing sequence number is not converted into a church name or inferred from an older list.

candidates.name: Subordinate bodies of the remaining Antiochian archdioceses in Lebanon
candidates.status: hold for exact current first-party rosters
candidates.reason: The Patriarchate establishes the Akkar, Byblos and Batroun, and Tyre and Sidon parents, but their current first-party pages do not enumerate complete subordinate rosters. Geography, older lists, and incomplete search results are not converted into current body identities.

candidates.name: Tripoli and Koura parish remainder not individually reconciled
candidates.status: hold until the Archdiocese publishes stable exact parish pages or a complete current roster
candidates.reason: The official Archdiocese pages inspected here name the monasteries and shrines published in this batch. Additional communities are not inferred from institutions, clergy assignments, local maps, or historical references without a current body-level record.

candidates.name: Romanian Orthodox community in Lebanon
candidates.status: hold until the Romanian Patriarchate restores or confirms a current institutional body
candidates.reason: Older first-party reports establish Romanian Orthodox ministry in Lebanon, but the current official external communities roster does not list a Lebanon body. Historical ministry is not treated as proof of a current institution.

candidates.name: Map and search-directory Orthodox church leads in Lebanon
candidates.reason: A map result may identify a building or local name but cannot establish a current canonical parent or institutional body. No map-only lead is published without a competent Church source.

candidates.name: Historical Orthodox churches and monasteries without a current body record
candidates.status: excluded until a competent Church source establishes current worship or administration
candidates.reason: Historical fabric, an older dedication, or an occasional visit does not establish a current parish, monastery, or recurring worship body.

candidates.name: Independent or self-described Orthodox bodies in Lebanon
candidates.status: not published under the directory entry rule
candidates.reason: No body discovered only through a self-description or general directory receives a row unless a current canonical Eastern Orthodox Church lists it among its own.

reconciliation.result: Sixteen exact bodies are published from the live Archdiocese sequence. The absent number 13 remains a documented gap rather than an invented or historical row.

reconciliation.issue: Patriarchal monasteries and the Younes shrine
reconciliation.result: The two monasteries answer directly to the Patriarchate of Antioch. The Younes shrine is nested beneath the Balamand monastery because the official records establish that relationship, rather than treating all three as ordinary diocesan parishes.

The Bsalim metochion is published directly under the Church of Russia, with the Annunciation church at Jal El Dib beneath it. The two records are kept distinct and not duplicated as unrelated parishes. The metochion's own working site is recorded separately from higher-level Moscow sources.

The Church of the Unexpected Joy Icon of the Mother of God is added beneath the Archdiocese of Zahle and Baalbek. Current official reports establish its consecration, regular services, and service by clergy of that Antiochian archdiocese.

The Zahle roster's landline column is retained as parish contact. Its separate mobile column is printed beside named clergy and is not republished as an institutional contact. The Balamand and Shwayya monastery landlines remain, while published mobile or person-named email details are withheld. The Beirut hospital chapel's extension is withheld because the page supplies no usable base number with it.

exclusions.result: Syriac, Armenian, Coptic, and other Oriental Orthodox bodies are outside this Eastern Orthodox directory and are not merged with the Patriarchate of Antioch.

exclusions.scope: Schools, hospitals, charities, and administrative offices
exclusions.result: An institution is not published as a church unless the competent Church source also names a distinct worship body. Churches explicitly named within an institution remain eligible as churches in their own right.
Discovery-only bodies are not published until a current canonical Eastern Orthodox Church source names them within its structure.

Mobile numbers or email addresses printed beside a named clergyman are not republished as institutional contact details. A parish, monastery, or metochion contact is retained only where the official source publishes it for the body itself.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: Sixty-two exact current bodies are published from official patriarchal and archdiocesan records. Existing archdiocesan parents are retained, and subordinate bodies without an exact current first-party identity remain held.
The current official records establish the Bsalim metochion and its Annunciation church at Jal El Dib. Both are published under the Church of Russia.

Older official reports establish ministry to a Romanian community in Lebanon, but the current official external communities roster does not list a Lebanon body. The lead remains held rather than being presented as current.
No additional Lebanon body is published without an exact current first-party jurisdictional citation. Territorial possibility and search discovery are not treated as proof of a current body.
